status.title: Product status
status.intro: A summary of available capabilities and recorded follow-ups. The platform remains in beta and this status is updated with every release.
resolved: Intelligence copilot with SSE streaming, cancellation, verified citations and context-isolated local memory
Project and investigation context loaded server-side under RLS, with /help and /finding commands and suggestions based on real findings
Chat history is bounded and redacted; semantic cache is skipped when memory is present and remains tenant-isolated
First-party RUM with field Core Web Vitals and LCP attribution
Landing first-load about 17% smaller and immutable caching for static assets
Tenant-scoped AI L2 cache, findings/audits indexes and uptime_logs partitioning
/admin/usage dashboard with usage and AI cache KPIs plus a daily chart
Automated RLS, CSP and axe-core accessibility gates, plus end-to-end tests
Remediation-plan streaming and documented OpenAPI and CHAT-CONTRACT specifications
inProgress: TD-22: replace simulated scan progress with real intelligence_run_events status
TD-24: load and authorize floating Copilot context server-side instead of trusting client data
status.note: This status reflects the repository code, not a deployment verification. Pending items may change before release; roadmap dates are estimates.

roadmap.title: Public roadmap (estimated dates)
